entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A Wild West frontier plane where villains from across the Multiverse come to seize their fortunes and where an ancient vault has been found.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who forms a gang of the Multiverse's most wanted to rob the vault, and Kellan's father.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's son, who has tracked down his wayward father and is at risk of being swept into a villain's role.

entities.name: Oko's gang
entities.description: A gang of the Multiverse's most wanted assembled by Oko to pull off an epic heist.

entities.name: The Vault
entities.description: An ancient vault discovered in Thunder Junction, rumored to hide untold riches and power.

entities.name: Metronome storyline
entities.description: The storyline whose first act ends with this set.

events.summary: Villains from across the Multiverse travel through omenpaths to Thunder Junction to find their fortunes.
events.quote: The set features villains from across the Multiverse , who have traveled through omenpaths to find their fortunes and battle it out at Thunder Junction .

events.summary: An ancient vault is discovered in Thunder Junction, rumored to hide untold riches and power.
events.quote: An ancient vault has been discovered in Thunder Junction, and it's rumored to hide untold riches and power.

events.summary: Oko forms a gang with the Multiverse's most wanted to pull off a heist of epic scale.
events.quote: Oko has formed a gang with the Multiverse's most wanted (a.o. Tinybones , Vraska , Rakdos and Annie Flash ) to pull off a heist of epic scale.

events.summary: Kellan finally tracks down his wayward father Oko, but Oko's schemes threaten to sweep Kellan into a villain's role.
events.quote: Oko's son, Kellan , has at last tracked down his wayward father, but his schemes threaten to sweep Kellan into the role of a villain.
